item.title: Beijing Chocolate Museum from ¥29.9 (≈$4): Single Ticket with Stamp Booklet, was ¥198 — Family Ticket ¥198 with DIY
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket (with stamp booklet) — ¥29.9 (≈$4, was ¥198, about 85% off) · Valid Apr 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime

The Chocolate Museum (巧克巧蔻, Beijing branch) is a small, sweet museum that mixes chocolate art appreciation, chocolate knowledge, hands-on experiences and a boutique shop — a light, fun stop that works well with kids on a Beijing city day. The single ticket includes a stamp booklet to collect as you go around; the family ticket adds a proper hands-on element, with an advanced DIY session where you make your own chocolates (six pieces, plus a cherry chocolate) and two stamp booklets.

item.title: Longyan Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort from ¥299 (≈$42): 1 Night + Breakfast & Unlimited Hot Springs for 2, was ¥1,299
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, annex mountain room with private tub — ¥299 (≈$42, was ¥1,299, about 77% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Double-11 flash-sale tiers · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort sits in the green mountains of Liancheng County, Longyan — about a 3-hour drive from Xiamen, and roughly 15 minutes from the 5A-rated Guan Zhai Mountain scenic area and the Peitian Hakka ancient village. The resort is built around a large semi-open-air hot-spring park themed on Hakka culture, with 50+ pools — lavender, milk bath, fish therapy, herbal soaks — plus a spa house, an outdoor pool and a wave pool. Every room has natural hot-spring water piped in, with its own private soaking tub, so you can bathe without leaving the room.

item.title: Paradox Museum Shanghai (The Bund) from ¥59 (≈$8): Single Ticket to 50+ Immersive Illusion Experiences, was ¥158
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket — ¥59 (≈$8, was ¥158, about 63% off) · Valid Nov 6 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime · Money-Saver Card saves another ¥30

Paradox Museum has just opened its Bund branch in the heart of the Nanjing East Road pedestrian street — inside Central Plaza, a short walk from the Bund waterfront. It is a walk-through illusion museum: 50+ immersive paradox exhibits built around optical illusions, reversed rooms and hands-on trickery, designed to be photographed as much as looked at. It is a compact, one-hour-style stop rather than a half-day museum, which makes it an easy add-on between the Bund and Nanjing Road shopping.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel from ¥999 (≈$139): 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Park Tickets for 2 Adults, was ¥1,290
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, deluxe room + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 adults — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,290, about 23% off) · Valid Oct 17, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Double-11 deal · Refundable if unreserved

Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel is the stay-inside-the-park option at Haichang Ocean Park in Lingang, Pudong: you sleep steps from the gates, enter through a dedicated VIP channel, and get two days of unlimited park entry for two adults (family tiers add one child under 1.4 m). The headline tier adds breakfast for two the next morning, free parking and Wi-Fi, and the current Ocean Wonders Festival (魔都海洋万秀节, through Nov 15) — two brand-new haunted houses, a new Arabian-style riverside street, 150 roaming performers, a night-time orca show and a mermaid light show, plus six refreshed big ocean shows and 100,000+ marine animals across the park.

item.title: W Xiamen NINE Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22): German Food Theme Lunch or Dinner, 1 Adult + 1 Kid Under 1.4 m Free
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult buffet lunch, Fri–Sun — ¥158 (≈$22, was ¥268, about 41% off) · Valid Nov 7 – Dec 31, 2026 · Each adult brings 1 child under 1.4 m free · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

NINE restaurant at W Xiamen is marking the hotel’s 5th anniversary with a buffet deal built around a rotating food theme — and right now that theme is German food, running through November 30. Expect the live grill station (steak, German sausages), a seafood spread (big prawns, mussels, scallops, oysters — the garlic-grilled oysters get singled out), sashimi and sushi cut to order, Chinese and Western hot dishes, fresh soups, and a dessert table that riffs on Xiamen’s dice-game (博饼) tradition. Dinner adds hairy crab and the house “circle sausage”, and an autumn/winter hotpot option has just joined the menu.

item.title: Dongguan San Zheng Banshan Hotel from ¥399 (≈$56): Garden Rooms, Buffet Meals & a Jungle Water Slide
item.description:
Deal price: garden room + breakfast + eco-park tickets — ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥999) · 2 adults + 2 children · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026

San Zheng Banshan sits in the hills of Qiaotou, Dongguan, looking out over gardens and a 300-mu lotus lake — a proper wind-down base about 30 minutes from downtown Dongguan. Every tier covers 2 adults + 2 children (one child under 1.4 m stays free), and the headline ¥399 tier already bundles a garden room, breakfast for the family and two tickets to Qiaotou Eco-Park. Step up to ¥599 and the buffet dinner joins in: salmon and tuna sashimi, sushi, teppanyaki cooked to order (steak, chicken, fish), hotpot and a dessert table.

item.title: Hangzhou Wind Valley Grassland Play Pass from ¥99 (≈$14): Trains, Rides & Slides on 3,000 Mu of Grassland
item.description:
Deal price: child play pass — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥228) · Adult pass ¥168 · Valid September 1 – December 20, 2026 · Buy and use the same day

Wind Valley （风之谷） is 3,000 mu of open grassland in the hills of Lin’an, about 90 minutes’ drive from central Hangzhou — the place guests keep calling “Hangzhou’s Altay”. One pass covers entry plus the grassland train and mini train (“the train to autumn”) and 10+ rides: the jungle flyer, New Zealand scooter, rainbow slide, bamboo raft, grass flying, bumper cars, tank battle and more. Two rides — the sky flyer and the super slide — need riders 1.4 m and up. Tents dot the grassland if you want to slow down between rides, and the site runs interactive activities through the day.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco Hotel 2-Night Family Stay from ¥1,288 (≈$181): IHG Beachfront on the Coconut Dream Corridor
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a Superior King/Twin room (balcony) — ¥1,288 (≈$181, was ¥1,788) · Valid October 19, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · Double 11 promotion

The voco Sanya Bay is IHG’s lifestyle brand on the Coconut Dream Corridor — the golden beachfront strip of Sanya Bay. Step out of the hotel and you are about 50 metres from the sand and the sea; the airport is roughly 15 minutes away and the high-speed rail station about 20, and Tianya Haijiao, West Island, Nanshan Temple, Dadonghai and Luhuitou are all easy day trips. The hotel has 233 rooms, each with a smart toilet and Elemis toiletries, and its all-day restaurant serves buffet breakfast and dinner plus Mediterranean, Spanish and Cantonese dishes and local Hainan flavours.

item.title: Suzhou Jingzhi Farm Harvest Half-Day Camp ¥98 (≈$14) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Rice Cutting, Scarecrows & Farm Games
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 12) half-day camp — ¥98 (≈$14, was ¥128) · Valid October 24 – December 13, 2026 · 09:00–16:00

Autumn turns the rice paddies gold at Jingzhi Farm （鲸治·部落生态循环农场）, an eco-farm in Linhu, Wuzhong — and this half-day camp drops the family right into the harvest. The morning runs on farm work and farm games: a grain talk and farm-tool intro, rice cutting and threshing, scarecrow making, tug-of-war, egg tapping, a paper-plane contest, goose ring toss and pet feeding. Between games there is a rice-paddy oil-painting photo stop, a paddy maze treasure hunt and the farm’s net-famous rice-paddy swing, and every adult gets a free Americano. The egg-tapping game has a real stake: beat the other families and the day’s “egg champion” takes home a free-range chicken if 30+ families are playing (or 10 eggs if fewer); the paper-plane winner takes home stream-tracing tickets for next year.

item.title: Xiamen Portman Seven Star Bay Buffet from ¥219 (≈$31) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Lunch or Weekday Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m), lunch or weekday dinner — ¥219 (≈$31, was ¥298) · Valid July 15 – December 30, 2026 · Book at least 1 day ahead

The Portman Seven Star Bay （佰翔波特曼七星湾酒店） sits on the Tong’an coast in Xiamen, and its Le Wei all-day restaurant runs the hotel buffet: lunch 12:00–14:30 every day, dinner 17:30–21:00 (weekdays on this voucher; weekends need the weekend-dinner tier). The spread rotates with the season, but the shape stays the same — seafood, Chinese and Western dishes, and French-style desserts — and the restaurant will make baby food (steamed egg, white congee) for the smallest diners. One child under 1.2 m eats free with each adult; children 1.2–1.4 m take the child ticket, and anyone over 1.4 m pays the adult price.

item.title: Beijing Bird Paradise Exploration Park from ¥59.9 (≈$8): Forest Bird Encounters in Wenyu River Park
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥59.9 (≈$8, was ¥129) · 1 adult + 1 child ¥99 (was ¥199), 2 adults + 1 child ¥139 (was ¥299) · Opened September 2026 in Wenyu River Park · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy and use on the spot, refundable if unused

Opened in September 2026 inside Wenyu River Park’s Chaoyang demonstration area, the Bird Paradise Exploration Park blends native forest, bird shows, petting animals and wooden playgrounds into one family day out. The centrepiece is the parrot stunt show — trained parrots ride tiny bicycles, play basketball and bowl, presented by a team with 20+ years of bird training — followed by close-up feeding and photos with macaws and cockatoos. The petting farm has alpacas, raccoons, sika deer and rabbits to feed under keeper supervision, and the forest playgrounds are all wooden and unpowered: a giant grasshopper slide and butterfly climbing frame for ages 3–6, a shallow stream area for splashing and catching fish, and a giant bird-nest climbing tower with rope bridges and spiral slides for ages 6+.

item.title: Hangzhou Koala Jungle Adventure from ¥99 (≈$14): Treetop Ropes Courses in the Forest at Senbo Resort
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket, any 2 of 3 courses — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥128) · All 3 courses ¥129 (was ¥188) · Valid September 15 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy by 23:59 the day before

Inside Hangzhou Senbo Resort by Xiang Lake, Koala Jungle is a 4,000-square-metre treetop adventure park: 40+ crossings strung through the forest — suspension bridges, a Tarzan jump, high swings and a 70-metre Andes zipline — plus a 12-metre climbing wall. The equipment is French-imported, and coaches supervise every course. Three routes run by difficulty: green (1.2 m+), blue (1.2 m+) and red (1.4 m+), so families can start easy and work up; children 1.2 m and under do the green and blue routes with a parent alongside. A free resort shuttle runs from the hotel lobby to the course.

item.title: Hangzhou Paradise Double-11 Tickets from ¥99.9 (≈$14): Single ¥99.9 or Double ¥169.9, Entry from Noon
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥99.9 (≈$14, was ¥190) · Double ticket ¥169.9 (≈$24, was ¥380) · Entry from 12:00 · Valid November 2–30, 2026 · ⏰ buy at least 1 day ahead, refundable if unused

Hangzhou Paradise is one of the Yangtze Delta’s big all-round theme parks, split into themed zones — Maya Tribe, Lost Jungle, Adventure Island — with dozens of thrill rides, kids’ rides and live shows. The headline rides are the Maya Roller Coaster (an 800-metre red dragon hitting 80 km/h), the 60-metre Rain God Hammer swing, the Wind God Hand, a white-water flume, bumper cars and a carousel, plus a carnival parade with floats and performers. One ticket covers the whole park for the afternoon.

item.title: Shanghai Trampoline Park (Bounce Town) from ¥39.9 (≈$6): All-Day Play for 1 Adult or 1 Adult + 1 Child
item.description:
Deal price: single all-day ticket — ¥39.9 (≈$6, was ¥159) · 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.4 m) ¥49.9 (≈$7, was ¥199) · Valid September 1 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–20:30, buy and use on the spot

Bounce Town (弹力小镇) in Jiading is a 4,000-square-metre trampoline park that plays more like a whole indoor playground: rows of trampolines, a near-vertical giant slide and gentler wave slides for younger kids, a high-altitude walkway, go-karts, plum-blossom poles, archery and shooting, a climbing net and a rock wall — plus a 300-square-metre soft-play toddler zone on the second floor with a pretend supermarket. One ticket covers the whole day with unlimited replays, and parking is free for 4 hours.

item.title: Xiamen W Hotel HEAT Bar 2-Hour Cocktail Free-Flow from ¥138 (≈$19): 35th-Floor Skyline Bar, Any Night of the Week
item.description:
Deal price: 2-hour cocktail free-flow — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥446) · HEAT Bar, 35th floor, W Xiamen · Any night 20:00–02:00, any 2 hours · Valid October 28 – December 30, 2026 · ⏰ book by 20:00 the day before

HEAT Bar sits on the 35th floor of Xiamen W Hotel, above the neon of the city — a proper skyline bar for a night out rather than a hotel lobby drink. This voucher covers two hours of free-flow designated cocktails, any night of the week: pick any 2-hour window inside the bar’s 20:00–02:00 opening hours. At ¥138 against a ¥446 list price, it is less than a third of the walk-in cost of the same two hours.

item.title: Guangzhou Cave Adventure Park from ¥228 (≈$32): 1 Adult + 1 Child, 2.5 Hours Across 10 Cave Routes
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child, 2.5-hour caving ticket — ¥228 (≈$32, was ¥318) · 10 cave routes across 5 themed zones · Helmets, knee and elbow pads provided · Valid August 23 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unused · Buy by 23:59 the day before for the ¥228 advance price

Guangzhou’s “Elf Forest”-themed indoor caving park — over a kilometre of cave passages plus a giant maze cave — inside the Six Elements complex in Pazhou. One ticket covers 2.5 hours of caving plus a castle quest game across five zones: the Experience Zone (15 minutes, climb through the elf tree trunk, cross the high rope net and push through an ice world of snow blocks and stalactite columns), the Maze Zone (25–35 minutes, a karst labyrinth of stalactites, rubble and rope nets — watch out for the skeleton pit), the Science Zone (15–25 minutes, a Jurassic fossil world where kids dig for dinosaur, fish and trilobite fossils and hunt for a hidden treasure chest), the Magic Zone (20–25 minutes, a kaleidoscope ocean-ball mirror house and double-decker secret rooms) and the Challenge Zone (three routes: the 77-metre Ghost Cave Trail, the high-difficulty Extreme Challenge with slanted boards and yoga-ball chambers, and the Wind Cave where you push against winds from level 3 to level 7). A competition zone opens when matches are running.

item.title: Shenzhen Apsaras Qixingwan Yacht Hotel from ¥499 (≈$69): Sea-View Room + Breakfast + Kayaking at the Marina
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, 45㎡ deluxe sea-view room (king or twin) — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · 1-hour kayaking for 2 at Qixingwan Yacht Club · Free in-room minibar · Valid September 24 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ weekends at no extra charge, refundable if unreserved · Book by 15:30 the same day

A sailing-themed hotel right on the Qixingwan marina in Dapeng — every one of its 80-plus rooms faces the sea with a viewing balcony, so the “sea-view room” here is not an upgrade lottery. The deal pairs the room with breakfast for two and an hour of kayaking for two at the yacht club, plus a free in-room minibar (drinks and snacks in the fridge), free entry to the Dapeng Geology Museum (closed Mondays) and the Hetang Wetland Park, and marina perks: yacht-harbour photo spots, a canopy campsite check-in point, a photo-ready sailboat and a kids’ sand pit. Free parking and Wi-Fi included.

item.title: Shenzhen MGallery Fashion Town Hotel from ¥699 (≈$97): Themed Family Room + Breakfast + Kirin Cat Kids' Park
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, themed family room — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · Unlimited Kirin Cat kids’ park play · Valid to December 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 23:59 the day before

Accor’s MGallery hotel in Shenzhen’s Dalang Fashion Town — a new, art-led five-star where the rooms themselves are the attraction for kids. The themed family room is randomly assigned one of five themes (Alice AR Wonderland, Balala Little Demon Fairy, Milk Dragon, Chibi Maruko or Super Wings), so each stay is a surprise. All tiers include breakfast for two and unlimited play at the hotel’s Kirin Cat children’s park, and the 2-night tier adds a greenway hiking energy pack (2 fruit-and-vegetable juices, 2 waters and 2 sandwiches) plus 2 tickets to the Yizhihui Centennial Fashion Museum next door.

item.title: Xiamen Le Méridien Cantonese Dim Sum Set from ¥138 (≈$19): 10 Dishes for Two, Weekends at No Extra Charge
item.description:
Deal price: Cantonese dim sum set for 2 — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥168) · 10 dishes · Weekdays, weekends and holidays at no extra charge · Valid October 22 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refunded if expired · Book by 20:00 the day before

Le Mei, the Chinese restaurant at Xiamen Le Méridien, does Cantonese dim sum with a Minnan twist — the set for two runs: crispy roast duck, flaky egg tarts, Xiamen taro buns, Le Méridien shrimp dumplings, crab-roe siu mai, garlic steamed pork ribs, red-rice shrimp rice rolls, soy-sauce steamed chicken feet, stir-fried beef rice noodles, and two mango pomelo sago desserts. Served lunch (11:30–14:30) and dinner (17:30–21:00) in a quiet courtyard-garden setting, with a walk through the hotel’s central garden and lawn after the meal.

item.title: Xiamen Marco Polo Napoleon Pastry from ¥68 (≈$9): 2 Signature Slices or a 1-Pound Cake, Weekends at No Extra Charge
item.description:
Deal price: 2 slices of signature Napoleon — ¥68 (≈$9, was ¥96) · Self-pickup from the lobby lounge · Valid October 23, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ weekends and holidays at no extra charge, refundable if unreserved · Reserve by 17:00 the day before

The Napoleon is Marco Polo Oriental’s star dessert — layers of flaky pastry folded with butter and nuts, softening as you bite into a milky, crisp sweetness — and this deal is the cheapest way to take it home: two slices for ¥68, or a whole 1-pound Napoleon cake for ¥208 (was ¥258), a natural pick for birthdays, family gatherings and dates. The pastry is takeaway only; eating it in the lobby lounge seats is charged at the walk-in price.

item.title: Anji Yunbanjian Wild-Luxury Hotel from ¥528 (≈$73): Bamboo-Forest Room at 800 m, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Night Star family room or Qiyun mountain-view king room — ¥528 (≈$73, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · Bamboo stream tracing with gear · Moss terrarium DIY · Bamboo hike · Welcome fruit · First-day minibar · Valid October 22, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ no weekend surcharge · Book by 23:00 the same day

Yunbanjian (“half a room in the clouds”) hides in the virgin forest of Longwang Village, Anji — China’s bamboo capital — at 800 m above sea level, among 20,000 mu of mountain forest beside a 500-year-old golden pine. Just 32 rooms sit along the forest stream, built into the hillside so the hotel feels grown out of the bamboo grove rather than placed in it. The headline tier pairs the room with breakfast, bamboo stream tracing (gear included), a moss terrarium DIY, a blessing plaque, an herbal foot-bath pack and a bamboo forest hike — a slow, outdoorsy stay rather than a resort-with-everything one.

item.title: Changtai Shanwai Yueju Villa from ¥289 (≈$40): Two-Bedroom Family Suite + Hot Spring Park Tickets near Xiamen
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Moyun two-bedroom family suite — ¥289 (≈$40, was ¥558) · Breakfast · Unlimited Luyuechuan kids’ park play · 1 adult hot spring park ticket (each adult ticket admits 1 child under 1.2 m free) · Valid October 21 – December 25, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 23:59 the day before

A quiet, Chinese-style villa retreat in Changtai’s Mayangxi eco tourism area, about 42 km from Xiamen island and 2 km from Tianzhu Mountain National Forest Park — close enough for a weekend escape, far enough to feel like one. The resort grounds cover roughly 110,000㎡ of gardens modelled on Suzhou’s Lingering Garden, with pavilions, covered walkways and streams. The headline Moyun suite is 89㎡ with a 1.8 m double bed plus a 1.2 m tatami bed, and the deal bundles breakfast, unlimited play in the Luyuechuan kids’ park, and a hot spring park ticket — plus a ¥10 single-ride go-kart coupon usable multiple times during the stay.

item.title: Haining Yanguan Chaole City Stay from ¥499 (≈$69): Old-Town Inn + Unlimited-Reentry Theme Town + Qiantang Tide-Watching
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, old-town inn room (5 inns to choose from) — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥1,195) · Breakfast for 2 · 2 Chaole City tickets with unlimited re-entry during your stay · 2 Tide-Watching Scenic Park tickets · Heritage craft experience · Immersive “Tide Music” role-play game · Valid November 1, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 18:00 the day before

Yanguan, on the Qiantang River in Haining, is the town of the famous tidal bore — the “first line tide” written up in the classic essay Watching the Tide — and the birthplace of writers Wang Guowei, Xu Zhimo and Jin Yong. Chaole City is a 3,000-mu theme town rebuilt from the old city, themed around tide-watching and music, run by the same group behind Wuzhen and Yixing Yao Lake Town. Staying guests get unlimited re-entry to the town during their stay, plus a free shuttle, free luggage storage and a welcome snack, and can walk to the Confucius temple school, Wang Guowei’s former home, Jin Yong Academy and the old city wall.

item.title: Jiaxing Senbo Water Park Tickets from ¥99 (≈$14): Indoor Heated Water Park + Fantasy Island, Valid to June 2027
item.description:
Deal price: Water park single ticket — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥288) · 5,600㎡ indoor heated water park, 30+ attractions · Valid October 23, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable anytime if unused · Book by 23:58 the day before

⚠️ Important seasonal note: the indoor water park is closed for maintenance from November 2, 2026 to April 2, 2027, and tickets are replaced by Xihe Hot Spring during that period (open November 5, 2026 – March 28, 2027). Neither venue is open November 2–4, 2026 or March 29 – April 2, 2027, so plan around those dates. Fantasy Island stays open year-round. If you are buying right now, you are buying a hot-spring ticket that converts back to the water park when it reopens in April 2027.

item.title: Qingdao Xinjiang Wyndham Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): City-View Room + Hot Spring Vouchers + 50,000㎡ Pet Garden
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, deluxe city-view room (king or twin) — ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥999) · Breakfast for 2 · 2 hot spring vouchers · 1 pet-feeding voucher · 1 hour of ball sports (tennis, billiards or table tennis) · Indoor + outdoor kids’ parks, gym and pool · Valid November 3 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 19:00 the same day

A family-friendly Wyndham in Qingdao’s Chengyang district with a genuinely unusual perk: a 50,000㎡ European-style garden behind the hotel, complete with fountains, courtyards, ponds and a pet area where kids can feed the animals — the listing’s own pitch is that a walk, a play session and a photo stop are all sorted in one garden. Inside, the deal covers breakfast for two, two vouchers for the neighbouring hot spring (third-party operated, 12 hours per visit), an hour of ball sports (tennis, billiards or table tennis, pick one), the first day’s minibar free, and unlimited use of the indoor and outdoor kids’ parks, gym and pool during your stay.

item.title: Changtai Shanhaiguan Hot-Spring Villa from ¥298 (≈$41): Japanese Villa Room or Private-Spring Room in Zhangzhou's Banyue Mountain Area
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Japanese villa room (luxury king, tatami king or bathtub king, 3 options) — ¥298 (≈$41, was ¥588) · Breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child · Free use of the villa’s shared living room and kitchen · Valid October 22, 2026 – January 24, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry · Book by 23:59 the day before

A villa stay rather than a hotel room: Shanhaiguan sits among the villas of the Banyue Mountain hot-spring area in Changtai District, Zhangzhou — the hot-spring country between Xiamen and Zhangzhou city. The entry tier is a Japanese-style villa room with a choice of three layouts (luxury king bed, tatami king bed, or a room with a bathtub), and every booking gets free Wi-Fi, parking and use of the villa’s shared living room and kitchen — handy for families who want to cook or spread out beyond one room. Check-in is from 14:00, check-out by 12:00, and you show your booking voucher and ID at arrival.

item.title: Nanjing Suning Zhongshan Golf Hotel from ¥999 (≈$139): 52㎡ Garden Balcony Room + Kids' Castle Park, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, 52㎡ garden-view balcony room — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,499) · Breakfast for 2 · Seasonal afternoon tea for 2 · First-round minibar free · 200㎡ castle-style indoor kids’ park included · Valid October 21, 2026 – March 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 20:00 the day before

A spacious, quiet base on Nanjing’s green east side: Suning Zhongshan Golf Hotel stands on Huanling Road in the Xuanwu District, by the Zhongshan (Purple Mountain) scenic area. The headline room is a generous 52㎡ with a balcony and a 1.81 m king bed, and the tier bundles breakfast for two, a seasonal two-person afternoon tea in the lobby lounge (14:00–17:00), a free first round from the minibar, and unlimited play in the hotel’s 200㎡ castle-style indoor kids’ park — the kind of setup where a rainy day still works out.

item.title: Suzhou Golden Riverside Hotel from ¥398 (≈$55): Garden Room + Hairy Crab Pair + Kids' Park on Taihu Lake
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, garden-view king/twin room — ¥398 (≈$55, was ¥599) · Breakfast for 2 · A pair of hairy crabs (processing fee waived) + ¥100 dining voucher · Kids’ park, kids’ cinema, games room and DIY baking included · Valid October 22 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 20:00 the day before

A Taihu Lake family stay with the season’s signature extra: Golden Riverside Hotel sits on Huantaihu Avenue in Suzhou’s Taihu Lake resort area, and the headline tier pairs a garden-view room with a pair of hairy crabs — autumn’s Suzhou delicacy, with the cooking fee waived — plus a ¥100 dining voucher. Children are well covered without leaving the hotel: the kids’ park, kids’ cinema, games room and DIY baking sessions are all included, and there’s an indoor heated pool and gym for adults. Breakfast is for two adults; children under 1.4 m eat free, older children pay the full ¥88 breakfast price.

item.title: Xiamen SM voco Weekend Buffet from ¥178 (≈$25): 1 Adult + 1 Child Lunch or Dinner at the 'Shan' Restaurant
item.description:
Deal price: Weekend lunch, 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.4 m) — ¥178 (≈$25, was ¥268) · Saturdays and Sundays, 12:00–14:00 · At the hotel’s 2nd-floor “Shan” all-day restaurant · Valid October 22, 2026 – February 28, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry · Book by 23:59 the day before

A straightforward weekend family buffet in central Xiamen: the voco hotel at SM City Plaza (Jiahe Road, Siming District, served by Metro Line 1) opens its 2nd-floor “Shan” all-day restaurant for a weekend lunch or dinner buffet, with one child under 1.4 m included in every tier. Lunch runs Saturdays and Sundays from 12:00 to 14:00; dinner runs Fridays and Saturdays from 17:30 to 21:00. Dishes follow the restaurant’s daily spread, so the exact stations vary by day.

item.title: Yixing Yao Lake Town Stay from ¥599 (≈$83): Pottery Town + Hillside Train + Bird Show in Jiangsu
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Taolu boutique guesthouse (king or balcony twin, 30–40㎡) — ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥799) · Breakfast for 2 · Unlimited Yao Lake Town entry during your stay · “Flying Bird” show tickets for 2 + souvenir gift + dining discount perks · Valid October 20 – December 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 17:00 the day before

A stay inside a pottery town: Yao Lake Town (窑湖小镇) is a lakeside old-street-and-kiln resort in Yixing, the Jiangsu city famous for purple-clay (zisha) teapots. The town is built around that heritage — a recreated dragon kiln, old-street lanes, a bird show in a valley theatre, and the “Cloud Train,” a hillside mini-train looping through bamboo, tea fields and the lake (guests call the night run, with its water-screen, lights and fireworks, the signature experience). The town is open 09:00–22:00 with last entry at 21:00, and staying guests can come and go freely during their stay, with shuttle buses inside the resort.
